***
Invert an element of α. 
***
*import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Defs*

```lean
OrderIso.mulLeft_symm.{u} {α : Type u} [Group α] [LE α] [CovariantClass α α (fun x x_1 => x * x_1) fun x x_1 => x ≤ x_1]
  (a : α) : (OrderIso.mulLeft a).symm = OrderIso.mulLeft a⁻¹
```

```lean
OrderIso.addLeft_symm.{u} {α : Type u} [AddGroup α] [LE α]
  [CovariantClass α α (fun x x_1 => x + x_1) fun x x_1 => x ≤ x_1] (a : α) :
  (OrderIso.addLeft a).symm = OrderIso.addLeft (-a)
```
